rows.grounds: bahuvrihi/tatpuruṣa compound kuliśa-pramukha in instrumental plural, qualifying cihnaiḥ
instrumental plural noun indicating the means or distinguishing signs
bahuvrihi compound describing the figure as having soles marked by those signs

items.question: Which distinguishing marks characterize the clear soles of the described divine figure?
premises: The figure bears specific marks as identifying signs.
These marks include the thunderbolt and other emblems.
The figure's own clear soles are marked by these signs.
items.inference: The described figure is distinguished by clear soles bearing the thunderbolt and other characteristic marks.
uncertainties: The full list of marks included under pramukhaiḥ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: His own clear soles are marked with signs such as the thunderbolt and others.
